description: A real Sudoku game with unique-solution puzzles — three difficulties, hints, live mistake checking, and win detection.

faqs.a: Each puzzle starts from a fully solved grid with cells removed one by one, keeping only removals that leave exactly one solution — verified by a backtracking solver.
Easy starts with 45 given numbers, Medium with 35, and Hard with only 28 givens.
Yes — an entry that can't be part of the solution turns red immediately and adds to your Mistakes counter.
faqs.q: Does the game check my entries?

faqs.a: Fill every cell so each row, column, and 3×3 box contains the digits 1–9 exactly once.

howto: Pick a difficulty and press New game.
Select a cell, then tap a number (1–9) or type it.
Wrong entries turn red; use Hint when stuck.
Complete every row, column, and 3×3 box to win.
title: Sudoku Game
